item.title: Ecommerce Website Figma Design
item.description: 15-25 USD/hr | We are a website specializing in mechanical tools. Before the development, I need someone to help me design a Figma design diagram. Note that we are a B2B website, not a B2C website. Therefore, we do not need the design of shopping buttons and checkout pages. I have found some corresponding reference websites for each page, so that we can clearly know how to design. Deliverables My request is quite simple. I need to work on the weekend and have at least five years of experience in Figma design management. You should have your own unique insights into design. The number of pages is not large. If possible, please bring your past works to contact me. I will provide a detailed introduction of the details.

item.title: Shopify Redesign Mockups Needed
item.description:
250-750 CAD | My Shopify store needs a fresh look that boosts sales while making the browsing experience smoother and more engaging. I want to start with the two pages that matter most—​the Home page and key Product pages—​and I need a designer who can show me exactly how they’ll evolve by presenting clear, conversion-focused mock-ups.
Here’s what I’m looking for: • Two high-fidelity mock-ups (Home + Product page) created in Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch, or a comparable design tool. • A short rationale for each layout that explains how the changes support stronger merchandising, quicker decision-making, and an overall better user journey. • Mobile-first considerations baked in, so the concepts translate seamlessly across devices.
Please include links to past work—​especially any Shopify redesigns—​so I can see your visual style and problem-solving approach in action. If your portfolio shows a knack for balancing strong aesthetics with measurable performance gains, we’ll be a great fit.

item.title: AI Driven Sales Platform Setup
item.description:
250-750 USD | I have a finished logo and a clear product line; what I need now is an end-to-end digital sales engine that joins a smart website with an engaging Instagram presence.
First, the website. It will be a single-scroll landing page that introduces the products, answers common questions, and captures visitor details. An AI chatbot should sit on every section to handle customer support in real time, while an automated lead-scoring workflow nurtures prospects in the background and reminds me whom to call next. All data flowing through these tools must be stored cleanly for future campaigns.
The same AI layer will drive after-sales care. Once a purchase is logged, automated reminders and update messages have to reach customers through WhatsApp—my preferred channel—without manual intervention.
On Instagram, I want a steady stream of product highlights, feature spotlights, and timely industry news or tips that funnel followers back to the site. Branded templates, short captions, and a posting calendar will help keep everything on message and on schedule.
Speed matters. I would like to see the first live version of the site, chatbot, and lead workflow quickly, then continue working together on iterations, new content, and routine maintenance over the long term.
Key deliverables: • Responsive landing page with AI chatbot, lead scoring, and connected forms • WhatsApp automation for post-purchase reminders and updates • Initial set of Instagram visuals and captions covering product features and industry tips • Clean data storage with easy export for marketing use
Completion of each milestone will be verified by live tests of the chatbot responses, lead capture accuracy, and WhatsApp message flow.

item.title: Comprehensive Travel Agency Platform Development
item.description:
5000-10000 CAD | I'm looking for an experienced developer to create both a website and a mobile app for my travel agency. This platform will serve both B2C and B2B clients.
The primary functions of the platform should include: - Booking system for flights, hotels, and travel packages. - Travel packages showcase, highlighting various options. - User reviews and ratings to enhance credibility and user experience.
Additionally, the platform must integrate with third-party services: - Payment gateways for secure transactions. - CRM systems to manage customer relationships effectively.
Ideal candidates should have: - Proven experience in developing both websites and mobile apps, preferably in the travel industry. - Strong knowledge of booking systems and integration with payment gateways and CRM systems. - Expertise in UI/UX design to ensure a seamless and engaging user experience.
Please provide examples of similar projects you've completed and your approach to this development. Looking forward to your bids!

item.title: Social Media Revamp, App Development, and Online Store Setup for Luxury Spa
item.description:
1000-2000 USD | We are seeking a skilled freelancer to revitalize our spa's online presence and enhance customer engagement. The ideal candidate will manage our social media accounts, create engaging short streaming videos, and develop content that highlights our white-glove service and elegance. We want to create content that gives our customers a warm, uplifting experience—something that truly resonates with them and makes them eager to be a part of what we offer.
Additionally, we would like to explore creating an app that allows customers to access our website's membership portal seamlessly. The app should also support an online store where both customers and spa personnel, such as estheticians and massage therapists, can order products via the website or app.
Initially, we’d like to explore what you can deliver before deciding on a long-term monthly management arrangement.
Deliverables include: - Social media account management (strategy, posting, engagement) - High-quality video production for promotional use - Content creation aligned with our brand's luxury image and emotional connection goals - Ad campaigns to boost visibility and reach - App development for membership portal access - Online store setup for product ordering via website or app

item.title: Shopify Skincare Store
item.description:
250-750 USD | I’m launching an online shop dedicated exclusively to skin-care creams and need a Shopify expert to turn the concept into a streamlined, conversion-focused store. The visual direction is minimalistic and clean—think generous white space, subtle typography and a layout that lets product imagery and ingredient details do the talking.
Core build requirements • Theme setup or custom Liquid work that reflects the minimalist aesthetic on both desktop and mobile. • Product pages ready for rich content: high-resolution photos, INCI ingredient lists and usage tips. • Integrated customer reviews so buyers can rate and share before-and-after feedback. • A subscription option (monthly, bi-monthly, etc.) tied to Shopify’s native checkout or apps like ReCharge—whichever fits best—so returning customers get their refills automatically. • Wholesale account functionality with tiered pricing visible only to approved B2B users. • Basic loyalty or reward points or coupon framework in place; I’m open to the best-fit app you recommend. • Essential pages (About, FAQ, Contact, Privacy, Terms) and navigation flow set up. • Payment gateways, shipping zones, taxes and SEO-friendly URLs configured and tested. • ADA Compliance
Acceptance criteria 1. Store passes Shopify theme check with zero critical issues. 2. Reviews, subscription and wholesale features operate smoothly on a staging URL before we go live. 3. PageSpeed Insights scores above 85 on mobile and 90 on desktop for the home page. 4. I receive a brief hand-off guide covering app settings configuration, how to update and how to add new products. Admin user name and password provided. 5. SEO ready and compatible
If you have a portfolio of clean, modern Shopify builds—especially in beauty or wellness—let’s discuss timelines and milestones.

item.title: IntimateMD Site & Ad Launch
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | I’m ready to take intimateMD.com from concept to conversion. The core of the project is a clean, professional, minimalistic website that makes it effortless for visitors to browse and buy our telehealth-related products. I’ll supply brand guidelines, product details, and copy; I’m counting on you to translate that into a fast, mobile-first storefront with intuitive navigation, secure checkout, and HIPAA-compliant intake where needed.
Once the site is live, I want immediate traction through highly targeted Social Media Ads. Your role is to plan, build, and optimize campaigns on the major social platforms, install tracking pixels, and set up retargeting so every ad dollar drives measurable sales. If future expansion into Google Ads or email funnels makes sense, I’m open to your recommendations—right now, however, social channels are the priority.
Key deliverables • Fully designed and developed intimateMD.com (WordPress, Shopify, or a stack you recommend) • E-commerce setup with payment gateway, product pages, and essential legal/telehealth disclaimers • Speed, SEO, and analytics configuration (GA4, Meta pixel, etc.) • Launch and management of initial social ad campaigns, including creative, copy, and A/B tests • Clear reporting on spend, clicks, and conversions tied back to the site
Success looks like a polished site that converts and a paid traffic engine that hits agreed sales targets within the first month. If you can own both halves of this launch, let’s talk timelines and milestones so we can open the digital doors of intimateMD.com.

item.title: Luxury Jewelry Shopify Store Build
item.description:
250-750 USD | I run a diamond and fine-jewelry brand and need a sophisticated online storefront built on Shopify, my preferred platform. The site must look and feel luxurious, load quickly, and make it effortless for visitors to browse collections, study detailed specifications, and check out with complete confidence.
What I need you to handle • A clean, modern design that reinforces the premium nature of our pieces • Full Shopify setup—theme (custom or heavily tailored), collections, product pages, payment gateway, taxes, and shipping rules • Security best practices so every transaction is protected • Guidance through the initial product launch and clear hand-off documentation
We’ll refine style choices, typography, and any advanced features during a Zoom or email session. I’m happy to consider extras such as customer reviews, wish-lists, or live chat if you feel they suit the brand.
To apply, show me examples of luxury or high-end e-commerce sites you’ve launched and outline your relevant Shopify experience. Please include an estimated timeline with key milestones from kickoff to go-live.
Acceptance criteria • Fully responsive Shopify site on our domain • Secure, tested checkout flow • Up to ten products uploaded with variant logic and spec tables • One-hour walkthrough so I can manage inventory and orders myself
I’m excited to see how your expertise can bring our jewelry collection to life online.

item.title: Squarespace Architecture Site Completion
item.description:

The portfolio area is top priority: every project requires engaging descriptions, carefully curated image galleries, and a few succinct client testimonials to frame our work.
I also need a detailed project inquiry form—something more robust than a basic contact page—so prospective clients can easily outline their scope, timeline, and budget. I also want a process page with our different packages. Beyond that, the site still lacks active social links and a clean SSO setup so the site is functional.
If you’re comfortable inside Squarespace’s editor, can write or refine architecture-focused copy, optimize image galleries, and configure forms, socials, and SSO without breaking the existing layout, I’d love your help.
Deliverables: • Complete portfolio section with project descriptions, image galleries, and testimonials ready to publish • Fully functioning detailed project inquiry form wired to our email and CRM . process page • Connected social icons (Instagram, LinkedIn, etc.) displaying consistently across desktop and mobile • SSO configured and tested for internal log-ins
Please let me know your estimated timeframe and any similar Squarespace builds you’ve wrapped up recently so I can look at your work!

item.title: Non-Medical Home Care Platform Build
item.description:
1000-3500 USD | I’m ready to launch a fully-featured, non-medical home health care agency platform that mirrors the depth and polish of Alora, WellSky, HHAeXchange, and Sandata—but branded and configured for my operation. Because this is a ground-up build, I need a partner who has already walked this path and can demonstrate it with a live URL, demo credentials, or code repository. If you have never delivered a comparable system, please do not reply.
What I expect the finished product to do • Web-based (desktop & mobile responsive) portal plus lightweight caregiver mobile app • Patient intake, profile management, and visit scheduling with drag-and-drop calendar • Caregiver roster, shift invitations, time-tracking, and electronic visit verification (EVV) • Automated billing, claims submission, and payroll calculations • Real-time dashboards and compliance reporting (HIPAA, state EVV mandates) • Secure messaging and document storage for care plans, signatures, and notes • Open API or native connectors for EHR feeds, clearinghouses, and major payment gateways
Project flow & checkpoints – Discovery and architecture sign-off – UX/UI prototypes for web and caregiver app – Agile sprints with bi-weekly demos on a cloud staging server – End-to-end acceptance test covering admin, caregiver, and client roles – Deployment, knowledge transfer, and 30-day post-launch support
To be considered include 1. A link or demo video that proves you have already built a comparable platform. 2. Your true fixed-price proposal—if you have done this before, you know the real number.
I’m prepared to move quickly once past work is confirmed and the scope is locked.

item.title: Shopify Expert for 2026 Halloween E-Commerce
item.description:

Research Halloween products and seasonal trends Analyze competitors, pricing, offers, and product positioning Identify products and niches that may be suitable for the target market Research customer interests and potential marketing angles Help evaluate which products should be tested

Review Shopify and advertising data Monitor traffic, conversions, advertising costs, and sales Identify areas that need improvement Recommend practical changes based on performance Help evaluate new products and marketing opportunities throughout the campaign

item.title: Premium Website Creation For IMPERIAX Community
item.description:
250-750 CAD | I need a premium website designed and developed for IMPERIAX, a private invitation-only supercar community.
The website must feel extremely high-end, minimal, cinematic, and exclusive — similar to a luxury automotive brand, not a generic car club template.
We currently operate in Toronto, Southern California, and Dubai.
What I need:
* Full custom website design + development * Premium responsive mobile and desktop design * Cinematic homepage using our own car/event photography and videos * Smooth, subtle animations and transitions * Membership application system * Applicants enter their name, email, city, vehicle make/model/year, Instagram, and other relevant information * Admin can review/approve applications * Events section * Gallery / community section * Toronto / Southern California / Dubai presence * Partners/sponsors section * Contact / social links
Design direction: Think private members club × luxury automotive editorial.
Minimal black/white visual system with very subtle yellow accents, strong typography, large photography, generous negative space and clean layouts. No cheesy racing graphics, neon effects, generic supercar templates, excessive gradients or clutter.
The entire website must feel visually consistent from page to page.
IMPORTANT: I will provide the official IMPERIAX logo, photography, videos and brand assets. These must be used instead of random stock supercar images.
I already experimented with AI website builders and do NOT want another AI-generated/template-looking website. I am looking for someone with strong UI/UX taste who can create a polished final product.
Please send me 2–3 examples of your best luxury/automotive/community websites before applying.
I need the finished website ready to connect to my own domain, and I need ownership/access to the website and source files after completion.

item.title: Digital Marketing for Independent Restaurant

item.title: Fix Search Console Index Errors
item.description:
250-750 USD | Our Google Search Console dashboard is lighting up with indexing problems across more than fifty pages of a site that was generated with the Cursor AI builder. The development team has delivered all front-end and back-end functionality, but they are not taking care of the SEO layer, so I now need someone who can focus exclusively on the console warnings and clear them out one by one.
The console is flagging three specific issues: • Pages not indexed • Server errors • Redirect errors
Your job is to diagnose what is really causing each of those warnings, implement the required on-page or technical fixes (robots.txt, sitemap, canonical tags, status codes, internal links, etc.), and then get every affected URL successfully re-crawled and indexed. I will provide full Search Console and hosting access, along with a direct line to the client for clarifying content or structural changes.
Acceptance criteria 1. All “Excluded” or “Error” URLs for the three issues above move to “Valid” after re-submission. 2. Server logs or equivalent proof show the underlying problems resolved (no 5xx or bad 3xx loops). 3. A short handover note explains what was changed so we can maintain it going forward.
Once the console is clean we will extend the collaboration to broader on-site optimisation, so view this as the first step in a longer engagement.

item.title: Minimalist Shopify Service Website
item.description:
250-750 EUR | I’m moving my service-based business onto Shopify and need a clean, minimalistic site that positions the brand clearly and professionally. The store function itself can stay disabled for now; the priority is a streamlined information hub that explains what we do and encourages visitors to reach out.
Here’s what I have in mind: the homepage should introduce the brand at a glance, followed by dedicated sections for concise service descriptions. I’d like each service to have its own sub-page or expandable module so users don’t get lost in long blocks of text. A simple, well-placed contact or “Request a Quote” form is essential, and a lightweight blog area for occasional updates would be a bonus if it fits naturally within the theme.
Design direction is strictly clean and minimalistic—white space, subtle typography, and a muted palette that lets the content breathe. No loud color splashes or heavy animations. Think modern SaaS landing pages rather than an e-commerce catalog. If custom graphics are needed to keep things visually consistent, you can suggest them, but they should stay within the understated aesthetic.
Please work directly in Shopify, selecting a theme that matches this vision (free or paid, I’m flexible). I’ll provide copy for the service descriptions; you handle layout, theme setup, and any light CSS tweaks required to keep the look cohesive across desktop and mobile.
Deliverables I need to sign off on: • Fully configured Shopify theme with home, services, about, and contact pages • Responsive layout verified on major devices and browsers • Contact form (or simple request-quote app) tested and functional • Clear guidance on how I can update text and images myself
If you have relevant clean-style Shopify builds in your portfolio, share a link so I can gauge fit. Let me know your estimated timeline and any questions that will help you quote accurately.

item.title: Malaysia Water Filtration Website Launch
item.description:
250-750 AUD | I need a full-service build for a new Malaysian water filtration brand. The goal is simple: a clean, modern site that spotlights our product line and makes it effortless for visitors to reach out for quotes or further information. All product images and descriptions are ready to hand over, so you can concentrate on design, layout, and smooth user experience rather than content creation.
Key expectations • Design and develop a responsive website (desktop, tablet, mobile) that reflects a professional, trustworthy water-treatment business. • Integrate my supplied images and copy into an attractive catalogue or gallery format, highlighting key specs and benefits of each filter system. • Include clear call-to-action elements—contact form, WhatsApp click-to-chat or similar—to turn visitors into enquiries. • Build on a CMS (WordPress, Webflow, or similar) that lets me edit products or add pages without coding later on. • Deploy the finished site to live hosting and ensure everything—from SSL to basic on-page SEO—is in place before sign-off.
I will handle any additional photography myself, so no shooting or retouching is required from your side. Please share recent examples of product-focused sites you have launched, outline your proposed timeline, and confirm which CMS or framework you recommend.

item.title: NEUTRINO AI SALES AGENT — $500 / 3–5 DAYS
item.description:
250-500 USD | Fixed Budget: US$500 maximum | Completion: 3–5 days
We are looking for an experienced Shopify + Amazon FBA/MCF + AI e-commerce specialist to complete Stage 1 of the Neutrino e-commerce system.
Neutrino is a Jamaican-origin natural body-care brand.
EXISTING SETUP
* Neutrino website — currently being built * Shopify account — already created and partially configured * Amazon Seller Central — already active * Products, branding and product information — already available
The website does not need to be rebuilt. The freelancer needs to add the e-commerce element and integrate the website with Shopify and Amazon fulfilment.
1. WEBSITE + SHOPIFY E-COMMERCE
Add/configure the e-commerce functionality so customers can:
Neutrino Website → Product → Shopify → Checkout / Pre-order
Including:
* Product/SKU setup * Product pages * Collections * Checkout/payment * Pre-order functionality * Inventory * Basic shipping/tax configuration * Domain connection * Mobile optimisation * Customer/order setup
2. SHOPIFY + AMAZON FBA / MCF Integrate the e-commerce system with Amazon fulfilment where appropriate. Target flow: Amazon → FBA → Customer and Neutrino Website → Shopify → Amazon MCF → Customer Freelancer must understand: Amazon Seller Central, Amazon FBA, Amazon Multi-Channel Fulfilment (MCF), Shopify/Amazon integration, SKU/product mapping, Inventory synchronisation, Order fulfilment, and Tracking synchronisation. The agent should: Understand customer needs and buying intent. Ask relevant questions, and recommend appropriate Neutrino products. Milestones - US$500 total.

item.title: Finalize Elegant Shopify Fashion Store
item.description:
250-750 AUD | My Shopify site for a clothing label is almost there—I now need a specialist to bring it across the finish line with a classic, elegant look that fits the brand’s tone.
Design & Theme The base theme is installed but still generic. I want the typography, color palette, and layout refined so the storefront immediately feels timeless and high-end when customers land on it. You’re free to tweak theme settings, add custom CSS, or suggest lightweight apps if they improve visual polish without slowing the store.
Products & Copy I will provide product photos, pricing, and key points for each garment. Your task is to upload the items, size charts, and variant options, then craft concise, benefit-driven descriptions that echo the brand voice and improve SEO.
Payments Shopify Payments is enabled but not fully configured. Please complete that setup and add PayPal and Apple Pay so checkout works flawlessly for major cards and digital wallets. Test transactions must run without errors before hand-off.
Deliverables • Fully styled storefront consistent with a classic, elegant fashion aesthetic • All clothing products live with clean titles, persuasive descriptions, and organized collections • Functional payment gateways (Shopify Payments, PayPal, Apple Pay) confirmed by test orders • Brief hand-over notes outlining any custom code, apps used, and how to update content going forward
Once these points are met and the store is ready for launch, the project is complete. If you’ve handled similar fashion boutiques on Shopify, feel free to mention examples in your proposal—screenshots or live links help me gauge fit quickly. Looking forward to seeing the shop perfected and ready to sell.

item.title: Missing Meta Verification Badge for Business page
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | My business account is officially verified with a Meta One subscription, yet the blue verified badge has refused to appear for more than two weeks. I have already opened a ticket with Meta support—no resolution so far—and I have tried the basic fixes: restarting both the app and each device, plus double-checking every relevant setting. Because the problem shows up on every phone, tablet, and desktop I use, I’m convinced it is a backend or account-level glitch rather than a local device issue.
I need someone who truly understands Meta’s Business Suite, Creator Studio, Business Manager and the new Meta One dashboard to dig in, pinpoint the cause, and push the right levers inside Meta so the badge finally displays across all my profiles.
What I expect from you: • Confirm the underlying reason the badge is missing. • Liaise with Meta’s internal support channels—or use any proven escalation route—to fast-track a fix. • Verify that the badge becomes visible on all devices once the issue is resolved. • Provide a concise summary of what was done so I can reference it in future.
If you have a track record of getting stubborn Meta account issues cleared up quickly, I’d love your help.

item.title: Revamp Static Website with Template System
item.description: 750-1500 AUD | Website Rebuild Brief We're looking for a freelancer to fix a website problem. Our site used to run on templates that kept every page consistent. When it got exported to static HTML and moved to its current host, we lost that template system. We want someone to rebuild the site with a proper template system underneath it, so the design stays consistent by default, and so our own team can update content without needing a developer for every change. The problem Our site has about 10 pages: a homepage, a handful of location pages, a few service pages, and a contact page. It used to run on a CMS with templates, where the templates kept every page looking and behaving the same. The site was exported to static HTML and pushed to a git-based host. That export process flattened everything into separate, standalone HTML files. There's no shared template underneath them anymore. Each page is now its own island, and the page layouts and UI have started to drift apart because there's nothing tying them together. To be clear: our branding (colours, fonts, logo) is fine as it is. The problem is the page design and UI itself. Layouts, navigation, and components are inconsistent from page to page and, honestly, look dated and rough. We want the rebuild to fix that, on top of the missing template layer. What's in scope • Rebuild the site using a static site generator (we're picturing Eleventy, but we're open to your recommendation if you've got a good reason) • Identify the repeating page types across our 10 pages (homepage, location page, service page, contact page, etc.) and build one template per type • Redesign the page layouts and UI components (navigation, headers, cards, forms, footer, etc.) so they're clean and consistent across every page type. Keep our current colours, fonts, and logo. Fix the layout and component design, not the brand itself. • Move page content out of hard-coded HTML and into simple content files (Markdown or a similar plain format) that templates pull from • Write a one-page reference doc capturing our current brand basics (colours, fonts, logo use) so it's documented, plus the new layout and component patterns • Set up the project so it deploys to our current host the same way it does now • Document how someone on our team edits content and pushes a change, using an AI coding assistant and a pull request What's out of scope • Moving our existing page content into the new system. Our team does that ourselves once the system's built. • A CMS, admin panel, or login-based editing tool of any kind. We're editing through an AI coding assistant and pull requests. • Any of our other websites or brands. This project is one site only. • New copywriting or photography. We're only talking about structure, layout, and system, not new content. • Changing our colours, fonts, or logo. Those stay as they are. Deliverables 1. Rebuilt site (static site generator, deployed to our current host, matching current URLs where possible) 2. Redesigned templates for each repeating page type, using our current brand but with cleaned-up, consistent layouts and UI components 3. A one-page reference doc: current brand basics plus the new layout and component patterns 4. Sample content files showing how a page's content is structured, so our team has a clear pattern to follow 5. A short written guide for our team: how to edit a content file, preview the change, and push it live using an AI coding assistant and a pull request 6. A short handover call to walk us through it Technical approach • Static site generator: Eleventy is our starting suggestion. It builds plain HTML from templates and content files, needs no server or database, and deploys straight to a static host the way our site already does. • Hosting: stays where it is now, no change to how the site is served. • Content editing: content lives in Markdown or a similar plain-text format, one file per page (or per section of a page). No database, no admin login. • Workflow: someone on our team opens a content file, makes the edit (using an AI coding assistant where helpful), commits the change, and opens a pull request. We're comfortable with that. We just want it to be a content edit, not a code edit. How we'll work together We'll give you access to the current repo and point you to the live site. We're happy to hop on a call at the start to walk through the current pages and answer questions. We'd like a short check-in partway through, once the templates are taking shape, before you build out all of them. That way we can catch anything off-brand early rather than at the end. One of us currently manages the repo day to day and will be your main point of contact for anything technical. A few more conditions for this to work: • We work in AEST. Please keep that in mind for call times and response windows. • We'd like documentation handed over at the end, not just working code. • We'll collaborate through MS Teams. • Before you start building, we'll do a 1.5 hour discovery and planning call together. • Payment is through Freelancer, in milestones. We'll agree on the milestones together on that first call. Sound fair? Timeline Four weeks, start to finish. A rough shape we'd expect: Week Focus 1 Review current site, propose template structure and brand guide direction 2 Build templates, check in with us 3 Finish templates, set up content files and deployment 4 Handover documentation, walk-through call, wrap up Budget $1,000 AUD total for the scope above. If you think that's tight for the work involved, tell us honestly and we'll figure out where to flex, either on scope or budget, before you start rather than partway through. Who we're looking for Someone comfortable with static site generators (Eleventy or similar), Git and GitHub, and who can look at an existing site and pull a clean, consistent design system out of it rather than starting from a blank template. Industry experience isn't required. What matters more is that you're tidy, you document what you build, and you can explain your setup clearly enough that a non-developer can follow it. If you've done this kind of "untangle a static site into templates" work before, tell us about it when you apply.
